micro.purpose: Supporting copy, field values, and compact controls.

label.purpose: Uppercase metadata, field names, and measurement keys.

numeric.purpose: Comparable prices, P&L, ratios, counts, and identifiers.

shadows.name: isolated-surface
shadows.purpose: Authentication and similarly detached modal surfaces.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, field, navigation, and switch state changes.

motion.name: module-swap
motion.purpose: Keyed opacity, clip, and 2px settle when the active module editor changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapse transitions and remove smooth scrolling when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committed next action in a local decision cluster.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #6f98f8; border-radius: 4px; color: #fff; background: #416fda; box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(39, 78, 165, .22); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 680; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { border-color: #91b0fa; background: #4e7de5; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #365fc0; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A compact secondary or reversible action that does not compete with the primary.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #363d49); border-radius: 4px; color: #c6ccd5; background: #11151b; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 680; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { border-color: #505967; color: #fff; background: #171c23; } .ds-button-quiet:active { background: var(--control, #0a0d12); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ledger Input
components.description: The standard compact field for plan values and supporting evidence.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 3px; color: #a7afba; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 29px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #303744; border-radius: 4px; outline: 0; color: var(--text, #f4f6f8); background: var(--control, #0a0d12); caret-color: var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); font-family: var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); font-size: 9px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #454e5c; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--blue, #5b8cff); background: #0d121b; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Tool Navigation
components.description: The selected destination inside the desktop tool rail.
components.css: .ds-tool-rail { display: grid; width: 52px; padding: 8px 6px; place-items: center; border-right: 1px solid var(--line, #242933); background: var(--rail, #090b0e); } .ds-tool-active { position: relative; display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #2f3950; border-radius: 5px; color: #b9ceff; background: var(--blue-soft, #17233c); text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-tool-active::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -7px; width: 2px; height: 18px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--blue, #5b8cff); } .ds-tool-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-tool-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A terse plan or connectivity state with a restrained semantic dot.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; height: 19px; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid #34466f; border-radius: 3px; color: #a9c0f7; background: #151d2e; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 760; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-pill i { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Ledger Panel
components.description: The flat structural container for tightly related operational evidence.
components.html:
Panel titleOnline

Supporting evidence stays close to the decision.
components.css: .ds-ledger-panel { width: 260px; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #242933); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text, #f4f6f8); background: var(--panel, #0e1116); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); } .ds-ledger-panel header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-ledger-panel strong { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 670; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-ledger-panel span { color: var(--green, #62c990); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 720; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ledger-panel p { margin: 7px 0 0; padding-top: 7px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #242933); color: var(--dim, #858e9a); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A binary selection inside the same compact frame used by fields.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; width: 180px; height: 29px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid #303744; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--control, #0a0d12); } .ds-segmented button { border: 0; border-radius: 3px; color: #747d89; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 680; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented button:hover { color: #c8ced7; } .ds-segmented button.ds-selected { color: #fff; background: #416fda; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Module Tab
components.description: The selected optional planning module with its compact enabled switch.
components.css: .ds-module-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 150px; height: 28px; padding: 0 5px 0 7px; border: 1px solid #3f5f9f; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--blue-soft, #17233c); } .ds-module-tab:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #5b8cff); } .ds-module-name { min-width: 0; padding: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 0; color: #dbe6ff; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 630; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch { position: relative; width: 18px; height: 11px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #4d6fae; border-radius: 8px; background: #284779; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch i { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 9px; width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #dce7ff; transition: left 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-module-name:focus-visible, .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Keyed Module Editor
components.description: The signature fixed-height editor that re-enters when its keyed module changes.
components.css: .ds-module-editor { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 106px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-width: 280px; animation: ds-module-swap 180ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-module-editor label { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted, #9aa2ad); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 620; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-module-editor input { min-width: 0; height: 29px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #303744; border-radius: 4px; outline: 0; color: var(--text, #f4f6f8); background: var(--control, #0a0d12); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 8px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-module-editor input:hover { border-color: #454e5c; } .ds-module-editor input:focus { border-color: var(--blue, #5b8cff); background: #0d121b; } .ds-module-editor input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue-strong, #79a2ff); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-module-swap { from { opacity: .72; clip-path: inset(0 18px 0 0); transform: translateY(2px); } to { opacity: 1; clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); transform: translateY(0); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-module-editor { animation-duration: .01ms; } .ds-module-editor input { transition-duration: .01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
Northstar should feel like a trusted trading instrument: ink-black, compact, exact, and built around evidence rather than presentation. Graphite panes, cool type, cobalt interaction states, and hairline rules create the calm density of an order ticket crossed with an auditable ledger.

The system is deliberately code-led and operational. Brand appears through proportion, restraint, tabular figures, a keyed module swap, and the three-stroke Northstar mark—not through gradients, decorative illustration, or a generic field of floating dashboard cards.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-black frame with tightly stepped graphite work surfaces.
Cobalt owns selection, focus, enabled states, and the primary next action.
Semantic colors stay sparse and carry evidence, risk, outcome, or connectivity meaning.
One-pixel separators and compact 3–6px corners establish ledger structure.
Geist Mono and tabular figures make numerical evidence scan as one aligned system.
Dense desktop chrome remains usable at 110% browser zoom and adapts without losing hierarchy.

rules.name: The Outcome Color Rule
rules.body: Cobalt owns interaction. Green, red, and amber are semantic signals only; never use them as general decoration or to make ordinary chrome feel lively.

rules.name: The Ledger Figure Rule
rules.body: Any value meant to be compared across rows, time, or state uses Geist Mono with tabular figures; prose and pending-state language stay in Geist Sans.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: At desktop width, protect one compact operating viewport—including at 110% browser zoom—before adding vertical space; optional detail should swap, collapse, or flow responsively instead of permanently extending the desk.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a one-pixel line and tonal step can express hierarchy, do not add a shadow.

rules.name: The Shallow-Corner Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce soft 12–24px product-card radii; Northstar's authority depends on compact 3–6px geometry.

rules.name: The Fixed-Editor Rule
rules.body: Optional modules change the content of one stable editor row; they do not accumulate into a vertical form stack.

dos: Do preserve ink-to-graphite separation with one-pixel hairlines before adding shadow.
Do use cobalt for focus, selection, enabled state, and the primary next action.
Do set prices, P&L, ratios, counts, and account identifiers in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep desktop workspace chrome at a 52px rail, a 40px command bar, and an 8px working rhythm.
Do re-key the active module editor and use the 180ms swap while honoring reduced motion.
Do verify dense desktop views at 110% browser zoom and in the 620px low-height mode.
donts: Don't turn panes into floating rounded cards; standard containers are flat 5px ledger surfaces.
Don't use green, red, or amber as decorative accents or substitutes for cobalt.
Don't introduce gradients, glass, blur, or deep shadows into the operating workspace.
Don't enlarge routine labels and controls into consumer-dashboard proportions; calibrated density is part of the product.
Don't stack every optional module vertically; one fixed editor replaces another.
